name: gizza-ai/csv-group-split
summary: Split a CSV into per-group files (zipped).

tool.description: Split one CSV into multiple files, one per distinct value in a key column, and return them bundled as a ZIP. `key` is a header name (header=true) or a 1-based index; each output CSV keeps the header. Useful for breaking a big CSV into per-category files.

key.description: The key column to split on — a header name (header=true) or a 1-based index. One output file per distinct value.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (kept in each output file, and matchable by name). Default true.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
